description: For empty input, every function interpretation of the specified finite structure returns its sole default point.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.empty_function_value.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n)
  (xs :
    Fin n →
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.support Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.emptyProblem)
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.emptyProblem.equations ⋯) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.functionMap
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.support Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.emptyProblem)
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.emptyProblem.equations ⋯ ⋯ f xs =
    none
